scope: Resources that cannot be lawfully completed through public retrieval alone
security_rule: Never share a password or institutional credential. Download an authorised copy yourself and upload only if its licence permits private local use.

missing_restricted_resources.title: TNM Classification of Malignant Tumours, 9th Edition, with current errata
missing_restricted_resources.reason: Commercial classification; public metadata do not provide the complete licensed tables and entity-specific rules.
missing_restricted_resources.requested_intervention: If you own an authorised digital copy, download it from your account and upload the file. Otherwise, validate the staging tables during medical review using your licensed access.
missing_restricted_resources.handling: Private local reference only; no redistribution or verbatim republication.

missing_restricted_resources.title: WHO Classification of Tumours Online — relevant 5th/6th edition volumes
missing_restricted_resources.reason: Subscription resource and living collection; complete tumour definitions and diagnostic criteria are not publicly retrievable.
missing_restricted_resources.requested_intervention: Provide authorised exports or local copies only where your subscription permits it, or validate pathology claims and chapter versions directly during review.
missing_restricted_resources.handling: Private local reference only; store chapter/version provenance, never reproduce protected text.

missing_restricted_resources.title: ICRU Report 83 — Prescribing, Recording, and Reporting Photon-Beam IMRT
missing_restricted_resources.reason: Commercial full report; central to IMRT prescription, DVH evaluation and reporting.
missing_restricted_resources.requested_intervention: Upload a licensed PDF if available through your institution or personal purchase.
missing_restricted_resources.handling: Private local reference only; recommendations will be paraphrased and cited.

missing_restricted_resources.reason: Commercial full report; needed for small-field dosimetry, SRS/FSRT/SBRT prescription, QA and reporting.
missing_restricted_resources.requested_intervention: Upload a licensed PDF if available through your institution or personal purchase.
missing_restricted_resources.handling: Private local reference only; recommendations will be paraphrased and cited.

missing_restricted_resources.title: ICRU Report 89 — Brachytherapy for Cancer of the Cervix
missing_restricted_resources.reason: Commercial ICRU/GEC-ESTRO report; important for IGABT concepts, EQD2, targets, OARs and reporting.
missing_restricted_resources.requested_intervention: Upload a licensed PDF if available. Do not use unauthorised copies circulating online.
missing_restricted_resources.handling: Private local reference only; no redistribution.

missing_restricted_resources.title: ICRU Report 78 — Prescribing, Recording, and Reporting Proton-Beam Therapy
missing_restricted_resources.reason: Commercial full report; relevant to proton prescription, uncertainties, RBE, motion and QA.
missing_restricted_resources.requested_intervention: Upload a licensed PDF if proton-therapy depth is a near-term priority; otherwise defer until the proton module is drafted.
missing_restricted_resources.handling: Private local reference only; no redistribution.

non_document_interventions.timing: After each course synthesis, not during source collection
non_document_interventions.requested_intervention: Validate France-specific applicability, resolve discrepancies between sources, and approve or reject the educational claims before release.
Provide institutional protocols only when you want the app to compare national guidance with local workflow; they will be labelled as local practice, never as national recommendations.
